title: B2: repair obsidian-vault-sync workflow (upstream obsidian infra)
description:
Plan: .agents/plans/2026-09-05_16-34-obsidian-down-last-good-cache.md — Workstream B, step 1 (epic tk-vau).

Every recent obsidian-vault-sync run Fails (one inspected pod had a git-sync container in Error; latest: obsidian-vault-sync-1788636900 'child failed'). The board-games push trigger depends on vault-sync Succeeding and annotating changed-files.

Steps: pull the failed workflow's main/init container logs (kubectl -n obsidian logs <pod> -c main, or Argo UI; KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/config-dell01, endpoint 192.168.68.91:6443); fix the cause (git creds/clone/path are the usual suspects). Likely owned by the obsidian infra repo — flag/PR there if so.

Also verify on the obsidian side whether vault-sync is cron-fired (epoch-named runs every 300s) vs webhook-fired: true push-only sync requires vault-sync to start from the obsidian-repo-webhook-eventsource on push, not from a cron.
acceptance_criteria: A real push to the vault repo produces an obsidian-vault-sync workflow that Succeeds and carries a changed-files annotation; no 5-min periodic vault-sync runs remain (webhook-fired only).
